title: Logistic regression from scratch
summary: A stable sigmoid, the binary cross-entropy loss and its gradient, and a gradient descent loop that records the loss.

mutants.bias_not_updated: Computes the bias gradient but never updates the bias in fit.
mutants.grad_sum_not_mean: Sums the weight gradient over the examples and does not divide by n.
mutants.grad_wrong_sign: Uses y - p and not p - y, so the gradient points uphill.
mutants.history_before_update: Records the loss before the gradient step and not after it.
mutants.loss_log_of_sigmoid: Takes the log of the sigmoid output, so a confident wrong prediction gives an infinite loss.
mutants.sigmoid_branches_swapped: Swaps the two branches of the stable sigmoid, so the output is 1 - sigmoid(z).
